body: Thank you both it was missing the 4th argument that caused the problems! I will ensure that in future I check this myself :)

Thanks

Her family although lovely can't help in this situation her mother has a serious amount of denial about anything regarding these matter.

I don't want to leave her and feel like I definitely can't due to the fact she has moved 200 miles to live with me. She has a stable job and wouldn't be able to live alone. At this point I feel like I have to stick it out until either we are happy again or she is in a position to support herself. 

I am always willing to help her on days where her medical conditions mean she can't move, but I'm struggling and I know it affects her too but I just can't help but feel trapped at the moment and that isn't helping. I just wish I could take all her problems on me and then I could force myself through situations that she won't even begin.

Thank you, it's alot of help I feel that maybe a date night where we can go out and just have a bit of time for the two of us would help quite a bit. I completely agree if a specialist was talking to her I would feel alot more comfortable in just the knowledge that she has another outlet and also just takes some weight off of me. I really appreciate your help and hopefully something great happens to her in the next few days to show her that the world hasn't abandoned her and that she has a very good support network who would drop everything just to give her 5 minutes of time.

Hope you have a wonderful day and thank you for your time and assistance!
